en.title: Comments in Code
en.body_md:
As your computer programs grow in complexity, writing notes to explain your thought process becomes incredibly valuable for yourself and your teammates. In Python, you can leave helpful human-readable notes called comments by prefixing any line with the hash character `#`. Whenever the Python interpreter encounters a `#` symbol, it completely disregards every single character on that line following it.

Think of comments like handy yellow sticky notes attached to a formal legal contract; human readers find them illuminating, but the official legal logic ignores them entirely.

```python
# This is a helpful comment. Python ignores it.
print("Hello") # Prints Hello
```

Comments are widely used in professional software engineering to document tricky algorithms, leave reminders, temporarily disable pieces of code during debugging sessions, and explain why specific implementation decisions were made in the codebase. Clear documentation ensures long-term software maintainability, allowing future contributors to comprehend legacy business requirements swiftly without tedious guesswork or accidental regression bugs. Professional engineering teams establish standard code review conventions to ensure comments clarify complex domain knowledge effectively.

te.title: కోడ్‌లో కామెంట్స్ (Comments)
te.body_md:
కొన్నిసార్లు మనం కోడ్‌లో మన కోసం లేదా ఇతరుల కోసం నోట్స్ రాసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటాం. `#` తో మొదలయ్యే దేనినైనా Python పట్టించుకోదు (ignore చేస్తుంది). వీటినే **comments** అంటారు.

ఇది ఒక డాక్యుమెంట్ పై అంటించే స్టిక్కీ నోట్ (sticky note) లాంటిది. చదివే వాళ్ళకి కనపడుతుంది, కానీ అఫీషియల్ టెక్స్ట్ లో భాగం కాదు.

```python
# ఇది కామెంట్. Python దీన్ని రన్ చేయదు.
print("Hello") # ఇది Hello ని ప్రింట్ చేస్తుంది.
```

try_it: Add a # comment with your age.

challenge.instructions_md: Print exactly `Python is fun!`. Also add a comment anywhere in your code that says `# My first comment`.
challenge.starter_code: # Task: Print Python is fun! and add a comment
challenge.solution_code:
# My first comment
print("Python is fun!")

wrong_solutions.label: print-comment
wrong_solutions.code:
print("# My first comment")
print("Python is fun!")

hints: Comments must start with a `#` symbol.
Write `# My first comment` at the beginning.
On the next line, write `print("Python is fun!")`.
hints_te: మొదటి లైన్‌లో # My first comment అని రాయండి.
తర్వాత లైన్‌లో print("Python is fun!") అని రాయండి.

teaching_notes: Students might put the comment inside a print() statement. Clarify that comments are not printed to the output console.

quiz.prompt_md: Which symbol is used to write a comment in Python?
quiz.explanation_md: In Python, a comment starts with `#`.
